description: Handwritten goal records: every state, every member and every journaled outcome, and records both readers refuse. Digests are the SHA-256 of canonical JSON, computed apart from the package. The names of the items, in order, are in names; refused fails the schema, and readerRefused passes it and only the readers hold it.
names: achieved with a waiver and every kind of failure
abandoned: what it left, and two attempts' deliveries
a second objective over an abandoned one
a journal of every refusal it can hold
